'''Braxus Lyn''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]], who worked as a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Lyn carried out a number of assignments for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and following their occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tirahnn/Legends|Tirahnn]], she was sent to work there as a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and keep the world's wealthly elite under control.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />

During the [[Battle of Tirahnn (Clone Wars)|Battle of Tirahnn]], [[Zolghast]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of all CIS forces on Tirahnn was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], so Lyn was sent to free him and transport him away from the battlezone. The Republic forces were preparing to move Zolghast to the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Solidarity (Venator-class)|''Solidarity'']], so Lyn disguised herself as the [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ezar Elasra]] and freed him. She then took him to a landing pad and began preparing a [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|''Sheathipede''-class transport shuttle]] so that they could leave Tirahnn. However, before they could leave, they were attacked by a group of Republic agents who were attempting to recapture Zolghast.<ref name="Galaxy at War" />
